title: Ask HN: Why do these LLM models seem to improve like clockwork over time?
author: iknownthing
snippet: It seems like these AI labs are able to guarantee more advanced models over time. How are they able to do this? Are they continually finding better architectures and learning algorithms or maybe even better data? Or are they simply making the models bigger?
